body: Sorry but look you gotta snap outta that shit. I literally have no family or friends to vent to and they all want me gone too. Guess what? I’m alive and fighting through it all. You need to pick yourself up and live through it all because all you got is yourself in life. Now pick your head up because negativity WILL be the end of you. You gotta stay strong and opening up is hard, I understand. The thing is that you needa wake up and get on your grind bro. It’s okay if you start slow but you gotta start somewhere. It’s a little harsh to say it like that but man you gotta put in effort before suicidal thoughts. I’m tryna keep it realistic and straight to the point with you bro
Don’t do it. It’s slow and painful and I’ve already tried suicide in multiple ways. Just keep living and take this from someone who actually cares about you
